title: Colossal DNA test on the wolf carcass is mostly unidentifiable

tellings.quote: So we sent the DNA off to Colossal and it comes back the majority of it they can't identify.

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, says DNA from a wolf carcass found there was sent to Colossal Biosciences, a genetics company. He says the results came back and most of the DNA could not be identified. If true, it would suggest something truly unknown about the animal.
